fewshot_map.A: Step 1: Call useTaskManagement().getTaskList(params) to fetch the list of tasks. Step 2: Call useTaskManagement().getPriorityList() to retrieve available priority options. Step 3: Invoke getTeamsByTenant({ tenantId }) to load all teams under the tenant for assignment. Step 4: Use getCurrentTeamList() to fetch teams the current user belongs to. Step 5: Call getAssigneeList({ params }) to list assignees filtered by team. Step 6: Call getUsersInTeamByTenants({ params }) to list users across multiple teams. Step 7: Call getTaskDetail(taskId) to retrieve detailed information for a selected task. Step 8: Call addTask(payload) to create a new task; if payload.files.length > 0, upload attachments via uploadTaskManagementFiles. Step 9: Call updateTask(payload) to update an existing task; if payload.files.length > 0, upload attachments. Step 10: Call getStatusList() to fetch status options and getMentionUsers(params) to retrieve mention suggestions. Step 11: Call addComment(params) to post a comment and getCommentByTask(params) to load existing comments. Step 12: Call getEmployeesByTenant({ params }) to fetch employees for selection. Step 13: Call getTeamsForTaskDetail({ params }) to fetch team context for task detail. Step 14: Call getTenantsTaskDetail({ params }) to fetch tenant list details. Rationale: This sequence covers all TaskManagement API handlers—from list retrieval and detail viewing, through creation, updates, comments, and auxiliary data endpoints—demonstrating the full end-to-end flow.
fewshot_map.V: const addTask = async (payload) => { /* create task then upload files */ };
fewshot_map.W: useEffect(() => { if (isEdit || isEditSubTask) { getTaskDetail(id); onChangeTenantId(tenant); } return () => resetTaskDetail(); }, []);
fewshot_map.X: validationSchema enforces .required() on name, description, dates, priorityId, statusId, teamIds, assignees, frequency fields.
fewshot_map.Y: initialValue sets defaults: empty strings, null IDs, empty arrays, and reminder with current user.
fewshot_map.Z: onChangeTenantId calls getTeamsByTenant or getAssigneesByTenant based on isTeamSelectionFirst flag.
fewshot_map.AA: useEffect on [reminder.isActive, assignees] updates reminder.users and reminder.userIds in form state.
fewshot_map.AB: handleTeamChange clears assignees, partitions CO vs site teams, then calls getUsersInTeamByTenants.
fewshot_map.AC: Step 1: In the effect that runs on mount, getStatusList(), getPriorityList(), and getTMTeamList(tenant.id) are called. Step 2: If isControlOffice, getTenantList() is also invoked. Step 3: A 'ReloadTM' listener is registered to call getList(), and the initial getList() is called at the end. Rationale: Ensures all dropdowns and initial task data load when the screen mounts.
fewshot_map.AD: getTMTeamList({ tenantId, isActive: true }) loads active teams for TaskManagement, called on mount and tenant change.
fewshot_map.AE: Tenant dropdown uses tenantList and onChange calls getTenantList to update project filter.
fewshot_map.AF: DeviceEventEmitter 'ReloadTM' listener triggers getList() on event and is cleaned up on unmount.
fewshot_map.AG: Step 1: getList accepts an optional page argument and builds filterParams including fromDate, toDate, statusIds, etc. Step 2: It calls getTaskList({ page, keyword, pageSize, ...filterParams }). Rationale: Encapsulates pagination logic and integrates filters for data loading.
fewshot_map.AH: The keyword state is passed into getList() as part of filterParams for live search.
fewshot_map.AI: useEffect on visible=true calls getCommentByTask({ id }) to load comments.
fewshot_map.AJ: onMentionInputChange detects '@' and calls getMentionUsers(params) for suggestions.
fewshot_map.AK: onSendMessage builds params, calls addComment(params), then resets message and calls getComments().
fewshot_map.AL: renderMentionSuggestions filters mentionUsers by keyword and displays matches in a Pressable list.
fewshot_map.AM: The 'message' form field holds new text; setValue('message', '') resets it after send.
fewshot_map.AN: MessageFloatingButton onPress sets visible=true to open the comment modal.
fewshot_map.AO: convertToMinutes normalizes days/hours to minutes by multiplying (24*60 or 60) or returns raw minutes.
fewshot_map.AP: addReminder checks for duplicates in reminder list and shows an error if found.
fewshot_map.AQ: onCheckEmail validates format; if valid, adds to emails list and resets input.
fewshot_map.AR: removeEmail filters out the email and updates form state via setValue.
fewshot_map.AS: A useEffect watches form changes and calls onChange(value) on each change.
fewshot_map.AT: An effect maps configure.timeUnit to 'days'/'hours'/'minutes' via I18n.t for unit labels.
